data.title: The Edge
data.about:
Introducing The Edge by Select Group, where urban living meets cutting-edge architecture. These two buildings, located in the centre of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay, provide a diverse living environment unrivaled in the neighborhood.

One- and two-bedroom apartments with breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Canal, and Business Bay are among the many apartment choices offered to tenants. Dual towers in The EDGE effortlessly combine historic and contemporary design. The architecture is unique and visually arresting due to the design’s flawless blending of the old and the new.

characteristics_module.title: Discover a taste of Dubai’s cosmopolitan lifestyle
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Surrounded by Burj Khalifa, Dubai Canal, and Business Bay
  • Multiple 1 and 2-bedroom unit options
  • 61,000 square feet of recreational space
  • Price starting from AED 1.1M
  • Handover in 2026
  • 40/60 payment plan

location_tile.title: The City at Your Doorstep
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Discover the vibrant lifestyle of Dubai at The EDGE, located in two of the most sought-after areas of the city – Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. Strategically placed, The EDGE offers residents a range of leisure alternatives right outside their doorstep. The area surrounding The EDGE is buzzing with activity, from shopping malls to trendy cafes.

The EDGE is also situated in close proximity to the Dubai Canal, a stunning man-made marvel that stretches over 3.2 kilometers. Take a leisurely stroll or bike ride along the canal and enjoy the picturesque views of the city. Furthermore, residents of The EDGE have easy access to major transportation hubs, including the Dubai Metro, Sheikh Zayed Road, and the Dubai International Airport, making commuting a breeze. Experience the best of both worlds at The EDGE, where the city’s bustling lifestyle meets urban living. With its prime location and world-class amenities, The EDGE is the perfect place to call home.
